entries.summary: K8 freezes a room Turn with read-only Agent memory. read-write becomes read, read-write-if-admitted becomes read-if-admitted, and a template without agentMemory freezes as read-if-admitted, so a room Turn loses memory_save. Other Turns keep the template value. A room Turn of a template without agentMemory now needs a device that advertises agent-memory-selection and agent-memory-read-if-admitted. A Host that vendors K8 copies src/rules/sync.ts.
